fields.q1: How much of your time is occupied by obsessive thoughts?
fields.q2: How much do your obsessive thoughts interfere with your work, school, social, or other important role functioning? Is there anything that you don’t do because of them?
fields.q3: How much distress do your obsessive thoughts cause you?
fields.q4: How much of an effort do you make to resist the obsessive thoughts? How often do you try to disregard or turn your attention away from these thoughts as they enter your mind?
fields.q5: How much control do you have over your obsessive thoughts? How successful are you in stopping or diverting your obsessive thinking? Can you dismiss them?
fields.q6: How much time do you spend performing compulsive behaviors? How much longer than most people does it take to complete routine activities because of your rituals? How frequently do you do rituals?
fields.q7: How much do your compulsive behaviors interfere with your work, school, social, or other important role functioning? Is there anything that you don’t do because of the compulsions?
fields.q8: How would you feel if prevented from performing your compulsion(s)? How anxious would you become?
fields.q9: How much of an effort do you make to resist the compulsions?
fields.q10: How strong is the drive to perform the compulsive behavior? How much control do you have over the compulsions?
